summary: Read the Lake configuration, the test runner script, both AlgorithmTest files, the root module, the tactic registration file, and Erase.lean completely, and counted declarations in every Algorithm/ file. All Algorithm/ files except the root module and Register.lean carry theorem/def/class/instance/structure declarations for verified data structures (DFinsupp, GetElem, heaps, dictionaries, union-find, adjacency-list graphs) and algorithms (DFS, Dijkstra); they stay searchable. Algorithm.lean is a pure public-import aggregator and stays primary-eligible under FILTER-007 because no auxiliary delivery path is verified. Register.lean registers the getElem_simps simp set and the get_elem_tactic_extensible macro, a proof-automation interface, and stays. AlgorithmTest/GetElem.lean and AlgorithmTest/UnionFind.lean contain theorem statements, examples with proofs, and definitions, and stay. Only lakefile.lean (Lake build configuration) and scripts/test.lean (an IO executable that spawns lake) hold no formal mathematics and leave the primary index.
